# `aitbc monitor alerts`

Configure or query monitoring alerts by name, type, and threshold.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc monitor alerts [OPTIONS] ACTION
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | choice | yes | — |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | — | no | Alert name |
| `--type` | choice | — | no | Alert type |
| `--threshold` | float | — | no | Alert threshold value |
| `--webhook` | text | — | no | Webhook URL for notifications |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc monitor alerts ACTION
```
